name: Jia Fang
source:
Jia Fang is a member of the Class of Exemplary Acolytes. They are the undisputed top of their class, but they do not spend a lot of time in class with their classmates. They're instead an internationally recognized prodigy in almost every field tangential to the Power, able to cooperate with top researchers in fields conceptually far from their on-paper specialty, Alchemy.

Jia Fang is Saoic, much like Utsushikome of Fusai and Ran of Hoa-Trinh, but is from the Saoic Arcanocracy rather than the Dai League. 

[From [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Jia_Fang]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
